nodes.notes: Generic ingress resolves to POST /webhook/v1/events; the source remains inactive and fail-closed.

parameters.jsCode: const status=Number($json.statusCode ?? 0); const base=$('Validate transform and sign').item.json; const retryable=new Set([0,429,500,502,503,504]); if(status>=200 && status<300) return [{json:{...base,retry:false}}]; if(!retryable.has(status)) throw new Error('permanent callback rejection'); const ledger=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); ledger.attempts ??= {}; const key=base.event_digest; const attempt=(ledger.attempts[key] ?? 1)+1; ledger.attempts[key]=attempt; if(attempt>5) throw new Error('callback retry limit reached'); return [{json:{...base,callback_attempt:attempt,retry:true}}];

const crypto=require('crypto'); const body=$json.callback_body; const timestamp=new Date().toISOString(); const nonce=crypto.randomUUID(); const bodyHash=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex'); const version='HMAC-V2'; const method='POST'; const path='/api/v1/lead-automation/results'; const identity='codestra-n8n-lead-automation'; const audience='codestra-middleware-lead-automation'; const environment=$json.callback_headers['X-Codestra-Environment']; const scope='lead-automation.results.write'; const key=$json.callback_headers['Idempotency-Key']; const material=[version,method,path,timestamp,nonce,identity,audience,environment,scope,key,bodyHash].join('\n'); const secret=$env.LEAD_AUTOMATION_CALLBACK_HMAC_SECRET; if(!secret) throw new Error('runtime callback secret unavailable'); const headers={...$json.callback_headers,'X-Codestra-Timestamp':timestamp,'X-Codestra-Nonce':nonce,'X-Codestra-Content-SHA256':bodyHash,'X-Codestra-Signature':crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(material).digest('hex')}; return [{json:{...$json,callback_headers:headers}}];
